intro: San Marino is a tiny country entirely surrounded by Italy, perched around Mount Titano.

chapters.title: Mount Titano
text: Three medieval towers crown the ridges of Mount Titano and appear on the flag; the old town is a World Heritage Site. On clear days you can see the Adriatic Sea.

chapters.title: Size
text: San Marino covers about 61 km², one of the smallest countries in the world.

keyTerms.meaning: A country completely surrounded by another.
